issues.issue: 543,740 of the unlabeled remainder (13,432,777; also detail[25] 862,037) is the Harrah's Casino fund's Taxes, which are probably the county's share of casino gaming tax (keno/lottery / gaming). The fund name does not name a tax, so keeping it unlabeled is defensible under the 2026-11-04 standard. It needs a person to decide whether the fund name is enough evidence.

The printed budget belongs to the whole nonmajor Taxes line, but it was put entirely on the unlabeled piece (862,037), and the lodging-tax piece (detail[24]) has budget_final null. That makes the budget-to-actual comparison on this piece misleading.
